items.name: APN Cleaning Service LLC
items.angle: Independent family-owned cleaning site has excellent proof since 1993, but long unstructured copy, scattered CTAs, and service-card noise hide the strongest reasons to request an estimate.

items.name: Alchemist Massage, PLLC
items.angle: Warm mobile massage site has a distinctive holistic voice, but the booking path, service radius, practical benefits, and license/contact proof need to be clearer above the fold.

items.name: Midway Dog Academy
items.angle: Dog training site has services, testimonials, and free-evaluation intent, but repetitive SEO copy and a large menu hide the fastest path for owners with urgent behavior problems.

items.name: Pete's POWERHOUSE Window Cleaning & Power Washing
items.angle: Exterior cleaning site has 35+ years of proof and strong service breadth, but slider-heavy messaging, duplicate phone paths, and a crowded service menu need a clearer estimate flow.

items.name: Eco Cleaning Services
items.angle: Eco-focused cleaning site has a solid health/sustainability promise and quote form, but typo/zero-stat issues, crowded service-area navigation, and repeated forms weaken trust.

items.name: Kelps Window Cleaning
items.vertical: window, gutter, light fixture cleaning and snow plowing
items.angle: Longstanding window-cleaning business has unusually strong trust proof since 1989, but the plain static homepage can make the free-estimate path, service differences, and proof hierarchy sharper.

items.name: Pure Windows
items.angle: Wix-built window/gutter site has strong since-1986 proof and clear services, but template residue, Wix social links, split “Book Now” paths, and sparse hierarchy create an easy trust-cleanup win.

items.name: Hearts for Paws LLC
items.angle: Pet-sitting site has a warm local service and visible pricing, but a major template leftover, vague CTA, typo-prone nav, and thin trust hierarchy make it a strong cleanup candidate.

items.name: Handyman Experts Inc.
items.angle: Family-owned handyman site has deep testimonial proof and a long local track record, but services sit below testimonials and the quote path needs stronger hierarchy for urgent home repairs.

items.name: EcoClean Carpet Cleaning
items.angle: High-proof carpet/restoration site has 1000+ reviews and 24/7 emergency services, but duplicated mega-navigation and mixed emergency vs routine cleaning paths add friction before scheduling.
